literature.headline_zh: 禽流感病毒本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期禽流感病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 所有未接种疫苗的雪貂都出现了严重的疾病并死于感染或被人道安乐死。疫苗接种 与灭活的 疫苗 降低了病毒滴度并延缓了疾病进展,但不能防止致命的结果。用减毒活 疫苗 免疫的六只雪貂中有五只在挑战中幸存下来,并显示出对鼻粘膜病毒复制的更有效控制。 [10.1038/s41467-026-79529-y]
结果显示,具有六个糖基化位点的进化枝 2.3.4.4b H5 HA 优先与全长(长柄)N1 NA 配对,而来自具有七个糖基化位点的早期进化枝的 H5 HA 蛋白优先与具有柄缺失(短柄)的 N1 NA 蛋白配对。 [10.1038/s44318-026-00967-x]
在 15 μg 剂量下,LNP-pDNA 疫苗 显着减少了呼吸道分泌物中的病毒脱落,并防止了同源 LPAIV H5N3 病毒攻击后肺部可检测到的病毒感染。二价 疫苗 诱导针对 H2 和 H6 亚型的 HI 抗体应答。 [10.1016/j.vaccine.2026.129374]
总共分析了 749 份配对血清样本,在 疫苗接种 之前在相当大比例的个体中检测到可测量的交叉反应 NA 抑制活性。疫苗接种 适度增加了 NA 抑制滴度,尤其是在 2009 年大流行之后。 [10.1128/jvi.00929-26]
8.3% 的条目提供明确的 宿主 信息,7.4% 的条目提供明确的地区信息;这些阻碍了对 宿主、区级和时间代表性的可靠定量评估,并且不能确定 监测 或病毒循环的缺失。登记并不是完整的人口普查。 [10.64898/2026.11.23.768755]
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 本期研究方向以入选文献实际覆盖的临床、流行病学、宿主生态、诊断或分子监测主题为准。
literature.headline_en: Recent Avian influenza A viruses literature
literature.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
key_findings_en: All unvaccinated ferrets developed severe disease and succumbed to infection or were humanely euthanized. Vaccination with an inactivated vaccine reduced viral titres and delayed disease progression but did not prevent fatal outcomes. [10.1038/s41467-026-79529-y]

The results showed that clade 2.3.4.4b H5 HA with six glycosylation sites preferentially pairs with the full-length (long-stalk) N1 NA, whereas H5 HA proteins from earlier clades with seven glycosylation sites preferentially pair with N1 NA proteins with a stalk deletion (short-stalk). [10.1038/s44318-026-00967-x]

At the 15-μg dose, the LNP-pDNA vaccine significantly reduced viral shedding in respiratory secretions and prevented detectable viral infection in the lungs following challenge with the homologous LPAIV H5N3 virus. The bivalent vaccine induced HI antibody responses against both H2 and H6 subtypes. [10.1016/j.vaccine.2026.129374]

A total of 749 paired serum samples were analyzed, with measurable cross-reactive NA-inhibiting activity detected in a substantial proportion of individuals before vaccination. Vaccination modestly increased NA-inhibiting titers, especially after the 2009 pandemic. [10.1128/jvi.00929-26]

Explicit host information was available for 8.3% of entries and explicit district for 7.4%; these prevent reliable quantitative assessment of host, district-level, and temporal representativeness and do not establish absence of surveillance or viral circulation. The registry is not a complete census. [10.64898/2026.11.23.768755]

literature.zh: 本期禽流感病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。；所有未接种疫苗的雪貂都出现了严重的疾病并死于感染或被人道安乐死。疫苗接种 与灭活的 疫苗 降低了病毒滴度并延缓了疾病进展,但不能防止致命的结果。用减毒活 疫苗 免疫的六只雪貂中有五只在挑战中幸存下来,并显示出对鼻粘膜病毒复制的更有效控制。；结果显示,具有六个糖基化位点的进化枝 2.3.4.4b H5 HA 优先与全长(长柄)N1 NA 配对,而来自具有七个糖基化位点的早期进化枝的 H5 HA 蛋白优先与具有柄缺失(短柄)的 N1 NA 蛋白配对。；在 15 μg 剂量下,LNP-pDNA 疫苗 显着减少了呼吸道分泌物中的病毒脱落,并防止了同源 LPAIV H5N3 病毒攻击后肺部可检测到的病毒感染。二价 疫苗 诱导针对 H2 和 H6 亚型的 HI 抗体应答。；总共分析了 749 份配对血清样本,在 疫苗接种 之前在相当大比例的个体中检测到可测量的交叉反应 NA 抑制活性。疫苗接种 适度增加了 NA 抑制滴度,尤其是在 2009 年大流行之后。 [10.1128/jvi.00929-26]。
literature.en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments. All unvaccinated ferrets developed severe disease and succumbed to infection or were humanely euthanized. The results showed that clade 2.3.4.4b H5 HA with six glycosylation sites preferentially pairs with the full-length (long-stalk) N1 NA, whereas H5 HA proteins from earlier clades with seven glycosylation sites preferentially pair with N1 NA proteins with a stalk deletion (short-stalk). At the 15-μg dose, the LNP-pDNA vaccine significantly reduced viral shedding in respiratory secretions and prevented detectable viral infection in the lungs following challenge with the homologous LPAIV H5N3 virus. A total of 749 paired serum samples were analyzed, with measurable cross-reactive NA-inhibiting activity detected in a substantial proportion of individuals before vaccination.

papers.title: Protective effect of seasonal vaccines against human-derived bovine H5N1 influenza virus
papers.abstract: Since early 2024, highly pathogenic avian influenza H5N1 virus (clade 2.3.4.4b) has caused outbreaks in U.S. dairy cattle, infecting other mammals including humans. Here, we evaluate the protective efficacy of two commercially available seasonal influenza vaccines against a human-derived bovine H5N1 isolate, A/Texas/37/2024, in influenza-naïve female ferrets. All unvaccinated ferrets develop severe disease and succumb to infection or meet humane euthanasia criteria. Immunisation with an inactivated influenza vaccine reduces viral titres in multiple respiratory and extrapulmonary tissues and delays disease progression but does not prevent fatal outcomes. By contrast, five of six ferrets immunised with a live attenuated influenza vaccine survive challenge and show more effective control of viral replication in the nasal mucosa. Live attenuated vaccination induces stronger T-cell responses, while the absence of detectable neutralising activity against the challenge virus suggests that cellular immunity, rather than neutralising antibodies, may contribute to protection. These findings demonstrate that seasonal live attenuated influenza vaccination can provide cross-protection against lethal infection with an antigenically distinct bovine-derived H5N1 virus, potentially through cellular immune responses in the respiratory tract. In this study, the authors show that seasonal live-attenuated influenza vaccination provides cross-protection against lethal infection with an antigenically distinct bovine-derived H5N1 virus in ferrets, potentially through respiratory cellular immune responses.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to assess the protective effect of seasonal influenza vaccines against a human-derived bovine H5N1 influenza virus, given the outbreaks of highly pathogenic avian influenza H5N1 in U.S. dairy cattle and its ability to infect other mammals including humans.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study evaluated the protective efficacy of two seasonal influenza vaccines in influenza-naïve female ferrets challenged with the bovine-derived H5N1 isolate A/Texas/37/2024. The study was conducted in 2026 and involved a controlled experimental setting with ferrets as the host model.
analysis.methods: The researchers used an inactivated influenza vaccine and a live attenuated influenza vaccine to immunize ferrets, then challenged them with the bovine-derived H5N1 virus. They measured viral titres in respiratory and extrapulmonary tissues and assessed disease progression.
analysis.main_results: All unvaccinated ferrets developed severe disease and succumbed to infection or were humanely euthanized. Vaccination with an inactivated vaccine reduced viral titres and delayed disease progression but did not prevent fatal outcomes. Five of six ferrets immunized with a live attenuated vaccine survived the challenge and showed more effective control of viral replication in the nasal mucosa.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret that live attenuated vaccination induces stronger T-cell responses, which may contribute to protection against the bovine-derived H5N1 virus, as evidenced by the survival of most immunized ferrets and reduced viral replication.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that seasonal live attenuated influenza vaccines may offer cross-protection against antigenically distinct H5N1 viruses, which could inform strategies for vaccine development and public health preparedness against zoonotic influenza threats.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to an animal model and does not include human data, which may affect the generalizability of the results. The evidence is strong as it directly compares vaccine efficacy in a controlled setting with clear outcomes.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the protective effect of seasonal influenza vaccines against a human-derived bovine H5N1 influenza virus, A/Texas/37/2024, using influenza-naïve female ferrets as the host model. The research highlights the potential of live attenuated vaccines to provide cross-protection against antigenically distinct H5N1 viruses, as evidenced by reduced viral replication and survival rates in vaccinated ferrets. The study's findings suggest that cellular immunity, rather than neutralising antibodies, may play a key role in protection. However, the results are based on an animal model and may not directly translate to human outcomes. The evidence is strong due to the controlled experimental design and clear outcomes, but the generalizability to humans remains a limitation.

The study was conducted in 2026 and involved a controlled experimental setting with ferrets as the host model.
elements_en.methods: The researchers used an inactivated influenza vaccine and a live attenuated influenza vaccine to immunize ferrets, then challenged them with the bovine-derived H5N1 virus. They measured viral titres in respiratory and extrapulmonary tissues and assessed disease progression.
elements_en.main_results: All unvaccinated ferrets developed severe disease and succumbed to infection or were humanely euthanized. Vaccination with an inactivated vaccine reduced viral titres and delayed disease progression but did not prevent fatal outcomes. Five of six ferrets immunized with a live attenuated vaccine survived the challenge and showed more effective control of viral replication in the nasal mucosa.
elements_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret that live attenuated vaccination induces stronger T-cell responses, which may contribute to protection against the bovine-derived H5N1 virus, as evidenced by the survival of most immunized ferrets and reduced viral replication.
elements_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that seasonal live attenuated influenza vaccines may offer cross-protection against antigenically distinct H5N1 viruses, which could inform strategies for vaccine development and public health preparedness against zoonotic influenza threats.
elements_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to an animal model and does not include human data, which may affect the generalizability of the results. The evidence is strong as it directly compares vaccine efficacy in a controlled setting with clear outcomes.

papers.title_zh: 季节性疫苗对人源性牛H5N1流感病毒的保护作用
papers.source_body_en: Since early 2024, highly pathogenic avian influenza H5N1 virus (clade 2.3.4.4b) has caused outbreaks in U.S. dairy cattle, infecting other mammals including humans. Here, we evaluate the protective efficacy of two commercially available seasonal influenza vaccines against a human-derived bovine H5N1 isolate, A/Texas/37/2024, in influenza-naïve female ferrets. All unvaccinated ferrets develop severe disease and succumb to infection or meet humane euthanasia criteria. Immunisation with an inactivated influenza vaccine reduces viral titres in multiple respiratory and extrapulmonary tissues and delays disease progression but does not prevent fatal outcomes. By contrast, five of six ferrets immunised with a live attenuated influenza vaccine survive challenge and show more effective control of viral replication in the nasal mucosa. Live attenuated vaccination induces stronger T-cell responses, while the absence of detectable neutralising activity against the challenge virus suggests that cellular immunity, rather than neutralising antibodies, may contribute to protection. These findings demonstrate that seasonal live attenuated influenza vaccination can provide cross-protection against lethal infection with an antigenically distinct bovine-derived H5N1 virus, potentially through cellular immune responses in the respiratory tract. In this study, the authors show that seasonal live-attenuated influenza vaccination provides cross-protection against lethal infection with an antigenically distinct bovine-derived H5N1 virus in ferrets, potentially through respiratory cellular immune responses.
papers.abstract_zh: 自 2024 年初以来,高致病性禽流感 H5N1 病毒(进化枝 2.3.4.4b)在美国奶牛中引起 暴发,并感染包括人类在内的其他哺乳动物。在这里,我们评估了两种市售季节性流感 疫苗 对人源性牛 H5N1 分离株 A/Texas/37/2024 对从未接触过流感的雌性雪貂的保护功效。所有未接种疫苗的雪貂都会患上严重疾病并死于感染或符合人道安乐死标准。使用灭活流感 疫苗 进行免疫可降低多个呼吸道和肺外组织中的病毒滴度并延缓疾病进展,但不能防止致命结果。相比之下,用活的减毒流感病毒 疫苗 免疫的六只雪貂中有五只在挑战中存活下来,并且对鼻粘膜中的病毒复制表现出更有效的控制。减毒活疫苗接种诱导更强的T细胞反应,而针对攻击病毒缺乏可检测到的中和活性表明细胞免疫而不是中和抗体可能有助于保护。这些发现表明,季节性减毒活流感 疫苗接种 可以通过呼吸道中的细胞 免疫应答 与抗原独特的牛源 H5N1 病毒提供交叉保护,防止致命感染。在这项研究中,作者表明,季节性减毒流感 疫苗接种 可能通过呼吸道细胞 免疫应答 与雪貂中抗原独特的牛源性 H5N1 病毒提供交叉保护,防止致命感染。

media_mentions.content_title: Nature Comms: Protective effect of seasonal vaccines against human-derived bovine H5N1 influenza virus
media_mentions.content: Avian Flu Diary Covering Pandemic and Seasonal Flu, Emerging Infectious Diseases, public health, community & Individual preparedness. NOTE: All AFD blogs are written by a human - any mistakes are solely mine. Thursday, November 26, 2026 Nature Comms: Protective effect of seasonal vaccines against human-derived bovine H5N1 influenza virus (translated) Credit University of Tokyo Press Release #19,430 Given the enormous logistics of creating, testing, manufacturing, and deploying a pandemic strain-specific vaccine (see Maggie Fox's SCI AM - A Bird Flu Vaccine Might Come Too Late to Save Us from H5N1), many researchers have looked for potential stop-gap benefits from seasonal flu vaccination. It's not a new idea (see 2008's Seasonal Flu Vaccine May Offer Some Protection To H5N1 and 2010's Seasonal influenza vaccine elicits heterosubtypic immunity against H5N1 that can be further boosted by H5N1 vaccination), but more recent studies have provided mixed and modest results at best. Some of those studies include: Nature Comms: Adjuvanted Influenza Vaccination Increases Pre-existing H5N1 Cross-reactive Antibodies mBio: Low levels of influenza H5N1 HA and NA antibodies in the human population are boosted by seasonal H1N1 infection but not by H3N2 infection or influenza vaccination EID Journal: Effect of Seasonal Influenza Vaccines on Avian Influenza A(H5N1) Clade 2.3.4.4b Virus Infection in Ferrets EID Journal: Investigation of Influenza A(H5N1) Virus Neutralization by Quadrivalent Seasonal Vaccines, United Kingdom, 2021–2024 Our most recent foray into this topic was last September's EM&I: Limited added benefit of seasonal influenza vaccination before A(H5) vaccination in mice and ferrets challenged with A(H5N1), which offered little encouragement on the effectiveness of using seasonal flu vaccines as a `prime-boost' for H5N1 vaccines. That said, there are known, or suspected, benefits to having been recently vaccinated against seasonal flu in the face of a pandemic strain. It still may provide some small boost to your immune response. HA neutralizing antibodies aren't the only immune defense against infection. The N1 component from H1N1 may provide some degree of protection against severe illness, although unlikely to prevent infection It could help prevent a co-infection with H5N1 and seasonal flu, which has the potential for being more severe. Co-infections could also help generate a reassorted `hybrid' virus (see Preprint: Intelligent Prediction & Biological Validation of the High Reassortment Potential of Avian H5N1 and Human H3N2 Influenza Viruses). Today, we've a study out of the University of Tokyo led by Yoshihiro Kawaoka and Professor Ryuta Uraki, that introduces a new wrinkle. Instead of only testing the standard quadrivalent flu shot (inactivated influenza vaccine), it adds a trivalent live-attenuated influenza vaccine (LAIV; FluMist) to the mix. Flumist is currently only available for those aged 2-49 in the United States, and carries a number of exclusions, including pregnant women, immunocompromised individuals, or those who have recently received antiviral medications. As the graphic at the top of this blog indicates, those lab animals who received the live-attenuated influenza vaccine fared far better (83% survival vs 0%) than those which were inoculated with the standard flu shot. From the press release: When the immune responses involved in these protective effects were examined, no neutralizing antibodies against bovine-derived H5N1 highly pathogenic avian influenza virus were detected with any of the vaccines. On the other hand, the nasal attenuated live vaccine induced a stronger T-cell response to the virus than the inactivated vaccine. These results suggest that the nasal attenuated live vaccine also shows protective effects against bovine-derived H5N1 highly pathogenic avian influenza virus, and that this effect may be related to an immune response involving T cells. However, these results are based on animal experiments using ferrets and do not directly indicate infection prevention or severity prevention effects in humans. While an intriguing finding, there are a lot of caveats to consider, including: This was a small study using one H5N1 strain and a limited number of flu-naive ferrets. While useful in flu research, ferrets are not a perfect analog for humans, which invariably have a lengthy and messy history of exposures to influenza A viruses and/or vaccines. LAIV vaccines can only be safely used on a subset of society LAIV vaccines contain live-attenuated seasonal flu viruses, which could provide opportunities for a co-infection with a pandemic strain, with a theoretical potential for reassortment. The primary takeaway is not that LAIVs are a panacea for a pandemic, rather that nasal vaccines and T-cell immunity may be a promising direction for future pandemic flu protection. Of course, additional research might pave the way for LAIVs limited use in a future pandemic crisis. That said, it is a fascinating study, which many will want to read in its entirety. Protective effect of seasonal vaccines against human-derived bovine H5N1 influenza virus Published: 25 November 2026 Volume 17, article number 11796 (2026) Ryuta Uraki, Kiyoko Iwatsuki-Horimoto, Maki Kiso, Mutsumi Ito, Seiya Yamayoshi, Masaki Imai & Yoshihiro Kawaoka Abstract Since early 2024, highly pathogenic avian influenza H5N1 virus (clade 2.3.4.4b) has caused outbreaks in U.S. dairy cattle, infecting other mammals including humans. Here, we evaluate the protective efficacy of two commercially available seasonal influenza vaccines against a human-derived bovine H5N1 isolate, A/Texas/37/2024, in influenza-naïve female ferrets. All unvaccinated ferrets develop severe disease and succumb to infection or meet humane euthanasia criteria. Immunisation with an inactivated influenza vaccine reduces viral titres in multiple respiratory and extrapulmonary tissues and delays disease progression but does not prevent fatal outcomes. By contrast, five of six ferrets immunised with a live attenuated influenza vaccine survive challenge and show more effective control of viral replication in the nasal mucosa. Live attenuated vaccination induces stronger T-cell responses, while the absence of detectable neutralising activity against the challenge virus suggests that cellular immunity, rather than neutralising antibodies, may contribute to protection. These findings demonstrate that seasonal live attenuated influenza vaccination can provide cross-protection against lethal infection with an antigenically distinct bovine-derived H5N1 virus, potentially through cellular immune responses in the respiratory tract. (SNIP) Overall, seasonal live attenuated influenza vaccination provided substantial protection against lethal hu-TX37-H5N1 infection in influenza-naive ferrets, whereas the inactivated vaccine reduced viral replication and delayed disease progression but did not prevent mortality. These findings suggest that immune responses beyond serum antibodies, including cellular and potentially mucosal immunity, may contribute to cross-protection against antigenically distinct bovine-derived H5N1 viruses. papers.abstract: Spillover of influenza A(H5N1) virus to cattle in the United States sparked global concern. We investigated whether endemic avian influenza viruses are potentially spilling over into domestic livestock in Egypt. We detected influenza H9N2 antibodies in 2.5% and H5N1 antibodies in 2.9%-4.5% of tested animals. Additional surveillance will elucidate host infection dynamics.

papers.title: Neuraminidase-based cross-protective immunity against H5N1 influenza viruses in humans
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Highly pathogenic avian influenza A(H5N1) virus continues to expand globally across wild birds, poultry, and mammalian hosts, and the detection of genetic features associated with mammalian adaptation underscores the need to define pre-existing human immunity relevant to pandemic preparedness. Although serologic and vaccine studies have historically emphasized hemagglutinin (HA); neuraminidase (NA) is a key antigen capable of providing protective immunity. Here, we performed a retrospective analysis of NA-specific antibodies in human sera collected across 10 influenza seasons spanning the pre- and post-2009 pandemic periods. A total of 749 paired serum samples (1,498 total) were obtained prior to seasonal inactivated influenza vaccination (T1) and 28 days after vaccination (T2). NA-inhibiting antibodies were measured by enzyme-linked lectin assay using N1 antigens representing three genotypes (B.3.13, D1.1, and EA-2021-AB) from clade 2.3.4.4b A(H5N1) viruses. HA responses were assessed by hemagglutination inhibition (HAI), and neutralizing antibodies by luciferase-based microneutralization. NA-inhibiting antibodies were detectable against all three genotypes across seasons, with measurable cross-reactive activity present in a substantial proportion of individuals before vaccination. Vaccination modestly increased NA-inhibiting titers, particularly after 2009–2010 following the introduction of A(H1N1)pdm09 into vaccine formulations. The highest responses occurred during post-pandemic seasons, suggesting enhanced cross-reactivity against H5N1 clade 2.3.4.4b viruses. In contrast, HAI activity against H5 was generally low or undetectable, despite detectable HA-reactive antibodies by enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay. These data indicate that cross-reactive NA-specific antibodies are present in human sera and can be boosted by seasonal vaccination, supporting increased consideration of NA in influenza serosurveillance and vaccine evaluation. IMPORTANCE The continued spread of A(H5N1) viruses and reports of mammalian adaptation markers heighten concerns about potential zoonotic transmission into humans. Most studies of human antibody responses focus on influenza HA, but NA is also an important immune target. By analyzing paired sera from humans collected over 10 influenza seasons, we show that NA-inhibiting antibodies cross-reacting with multiple contemporary genotypes from clade 2.3.4.4b A(H5N1) viruses are detectable and can be modestly but consistently boosted by seasonal inactivated influenza vaccination, particularly after the 2009 pandemic. The increase in cross-reactive NA responses observed during post-pandemic seasons suggests that A(H1N1)pdm09 exposure may have enhanced immunity recognizing contemporary H5N1 viruses. These findings highlight the importance of inducing NA-specific antibodies during influenza vaccination and of including NA in surveillance and in the assessment of vaccines intended to improve preparedness for emerging influenza viruses.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究对 10 个流感季节(包括 2009 年流感大流行之前和之后的时期)收集的人类血清中的 NA 特异性抗体进行了回顾性分析,以评估针对 H5N1 分支 2.3.4.4b 病毒的交叉反应免疫。
elements_zh.methods: 使用来自进化枝 2.3.4.4b A(H5N1) 病毒的三种基因型的 N1 抗原进行酶联凝集素测定来测量 NA 抑制抗体。通过血凝抑制评估HA反应,并使用基于荧光素酶的微中和评估中和抗体。
elements_zh.main_results: 总共分析了 749 份配对血清样本,在 疫苗接种 之前在相当大比例的个体中检测到可测量的交叉反应 NA 抑制活性。疫苗接种 适度增加了 NA 抑制滴度,尤其是在 2009 年大流行之后。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在调查人类对 H5N1 流感病毒的预先存在的免疫力,特别是考虑到 A(H5N1) 病毒在全球的持续传播及其对哺乳动物 宿主 的适应,神经氨酸酶 (NA) 作为潜在免疫靶点的作用。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究对 10 个流感季节(包括 2009 年流感大流行之前和之后的时期)收集的人类血清中的 NA 特异性抗体进行了回顾性分析,以评估针对 H5N1 分支 2.3.4.4b 病毒的交叉反应免疫。
analysis_zh.methods: 使用来自进化枝 2.3.4.4b A(H5N1) 病毒的三种基因型的 N1 抗原进行酶联凝集素测定来测量 NA 抑制抗体。通过血凝抑制评估HA反应,并使用基于荧光素酶的微中和评估中和抗体。
analysis_zh.main_results: 总共分析了 749 份配对血清样本,在 疫苗接种 之前在相当大比例的个体中检测到可测量的交叉反应 NA 抑制活性。疫苗接种 适度增加了 NA 抑制滴度,尤其是在 2009 年大流行之后。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 结果表明,交叉反应性 NA 特异性抗体存在于人血清中,并且可以通过季节性 疫苗接种 增强,表明 NA 作为血清监测和 疫苗 开发目标的潜在价值。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现支持将 NA 纳入流感 监测 和 疫苗 评估中,以更好地为新出现的 H5N1 病毒做好准备,该病毒会带来重大的人畜共患风险。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其回顾性设计和对历史血清样本的依赖而受到限制,但由于跨多个季节交叉反应 NA 抗体的一致检测以及经过验证的检测方法的使用,证据是强有力的。

papers.title: Molecular determinants of surface glycoprotein compatibility may explain the emergence of highly pathogenic avian influenza A viruses
papers.abstract: Abstract The emergence and spread of avian influenza viruses across diverse host species, exemplified by highly pathogenic clade 2.3.4.4b H5N1 viruses, depend in part on the functional compatibility between the surface glycoproteins hemagglutinin (HA) and neuraminidase (NA). However, the molecular determinants governing preferential HA-NA pairing remain unclear. Here, we show that clade 2.3.4.4b H5 HA with six glycosylation sites preferentially pairs with the full-length (long-stalk) N1 NA in birds and mammals. By contrast, H5 HA proteins from earlier clades with seven glycosylation sites preferentially pair with N1 NA proteins characterized by a stalk deletion (short-stalk). Our results indicate that the HA S/T160A mutation, observed in avian influenza viruses, abolishes the N158 glycosylation site and favors pairing with long-stalk N1, improving molecular compatibility and enhancing viral fitness. The N158 glycan underlies the preferential pairing of Gs/GD-lineage H5 viruses with short-stalk N1 proteins. These findings suggest that HA-NA pairing in avian influenza viruses is not an entirely stochastic process but is constrained by HA glycosylation status and NA stalk length, with implications for viral fitness and the emergence of clade 2.3.4.4b H5N1 viruses.

papers.title: One Health priorities beyond 2026: translating advances in science, surveillance and governance into prevention and preparedness.
papers.abstract: The interdependence of human, animal and environmental health and persistent gaps between multisectoral commitments and effective implementation were highlighted in The Lancet 2023 One Health series. Since then, advances in genomic and environmental surveillance, artificial intelligence and international governance have created new opportunities for infectious disease prevention and preparedness. However, avian influenza A(H5N1), filovirus outbreaks, antimicrobial resistance and the 2026 Andes virus cruise-ship outbreak illustrate continuing challenges in surveillance, coordination and response. Climate-sensitive infections, foodborne zoonoses and environmental contamination further emphasize the need for integrated approaches extending beyond emerging viral threats. This review critically examines developments since 2023, distinguishing established preventive interventions from promising but incompletely validated technologies, and both proximate biosecurity controls and structural socio-ecological upstream prevention, from early detection and outbreak containment. We propose a six-stage surveillance-to-action pathway linking detection, verification, joint risk assessment, accountable decisions, coordinated interventions and double-loop evaluation. An operational matrix illustrates its application across emerging and endemic infections, antimicrobial resistance and environmental threats. Five priorities address interoperable participatory surveillance, evidence-based upstream prevention, integrated antimicrobial resistance action, sustainable national governance that redresses sectoral power asymmetries, and equitable regional capacity. Effective One Health implementation requires clear institutional responsibilities, sustained financing, co-designed community and indigenous participation and rigorous evaluation. Progress should ultimately be measured by demonstrable reductions in infectious disease risks and improved protection of human, animal and environmental health.

papers.abstract_zh: 《柳叶刀 2023 年同一个健康》系列强调了人类、动物和环境健康的相互依存性以及多部门承诺与有效实施之间持续存在的差距。从那时起,基因组和环境监测、人工智能和国际治理的进步为传染病预防和准备创造了新的机遇。然而,禽流感 A(H5N1)、丝状病毒 暴发、抗菌素耐药性和 2026 年安第斯病毒游轮 暴发 说明了 监测、协调和响应方面持续存在的挑战。气候敏感感染、食源性人畜共患病和环境污染进一步强调需要采取超越新出现的病毒威胁的综合方法。这篇综述批判性地审视了 2023 年以来的进展,将已建立的预防性干预措施与有前途但未完全验证的技术区分开来,并将近期生物安全控制和结构性社会生态上游预防与早期检测和 Z​​XQTERMXQXZ 遏制区分开来。我们提出了一个六阶段的 监测 行动路径,将检测、验证、联合风险评估、负责任的决策、协调干预和双环评估联系起来。操作矩阵说明了其在新发和地方性感染、抗菌素耐药性和环境威胁方面的应用。五个优先事项涉及可互操作的参与性 监测、基于证据的上游预防、综合抗菌素耐药性行动、纠正部门权力不对称的可持续国家治理以及公平的区域能力。有效的“同一个健康”实施需要明确的机构责任、持续的融资、共同设计的社区和土著参与以及严格的评估。最终应通过传染病风险的明显降低以及对人类、动物和环境健康的保护的改善来衡量进展。

papers.title: In ovo administration of HA1-expressing Lactococcus lactis protects chicks against H9N2 infection via enhancing intestinal development and immune function
papers.abstract: In this study, we utilized recombinant Lactococcus lactis (L. lactis) expressing the H9N2 AIV hemagglutinin (HA) subunit 1 (HA1) protein and evaluated its efficacy through in ovo vaccination. At embryonic day 17.5, 160 viable embryonated eggs were randomly assigned to four groups and inoculated with either PBS, an inactivated H9N2 vaccine, an empty L. lactis vector, or recombinant L. The results showed that no significant differences in hatchability were observed across all groups (p > 0.05). In ovo injection of recombinant L. lactis- HA1 markedly increased average daily gain (ADG), improved feed conversion ratio (FCR) (p < 0.05), and elevated indices for the thymus, spleen and bursa of Fabricius, and elevated serum HI titers, HA-specific IgG, IL-2, IL-4, and IFN-γ, as well as increased mucosal SIgA concentrations and strengthened HA1-specific lymphocyte proliferative responses (p < 0.05). Furthermore, this treatment increased VH and the VH/CD in both the duodenum and jejunum, and upregulated the transcriptional levels of intestinal barrier-associated genes (p < 0.05). Following H9N2 viral challenge, chicks in the recombinant L. lactis -HA1 group exhibited milder clinical manifestations and less body weight loss, along with numerically lower viral shedding titers and less pronounced pulmonary lesions compared with the PBS and L1 groups. Notably, it conferred protective effects that trended toward a level similar to that of the inactivated vaccine. Collectively, in ovo administration of recombinant L. lactis expressing HA1 accelerates early intestinal maturation, potentially in part through the intrinsic probiotic properties of L. lactis, and additionally induces HA1‐specific adaptive immune responses in broiler chicks. These findings provide a theoretical basis for developing novel in‐ovo lactic‐acid‐bacterium‐vectored vaccines against H9N2 avian influenza virus.

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to evaluate the potential of using recombinant Lactococcus lactis expressing the H9N2 avian influenza virus hemagglutinin (HA) subunit 1 (HA1) protein as a novel in ovo vaccine to protect chicks against H9N2 infection.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study involved 160 viable embryonated eggs randomly assigned to four groups, which were inoculated with either PBS, an inactivated H9N2 vaccine, an empty Lactococcus lactis vector, or recombinant Lactococcus lactis expressing HA1. analysis.methods: The efficacy of the recombinant Lactococcus lactis- HA1 was assessed by evaluating clinical manifestations, body weight loss, viral shedding titers, and pulmonary lesions in chicks following H9N2 viral challenge. Additionally, immune-related indices such as serum HI titers, HA-specific IgG, IL-2, IL-4, IFN-γ, mucosal SIgA concentrations, and lymphocyte proliferative responses were measured.
analysis.main_results: The results showed that in ovo injection of recombinant Lactococcus lactis-HA1 significantly improved average daily gain (ADG), feed conversion ratio (FCR), and immune indices such as thymus, spleen, and bursa of Fabricius weights, serum HI titers, HA-specific IgG, IL-2, IL-4, and IFN-γ, as well as mucosal SIgA concentrations. analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that the in ovo administration of recombinant Lactococcus lactis expressing HA1 accelerates early intestinal maturation and induces HA1-specific adaptive immune responses in broiler chicks, which may offer protective effects similar to those of the inactivated vaccine.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that this approach could be a promising strategy for developing novel in ovo vaccines against H9N2 avian influenza virus, potentially improving vaccine efficacy and providing a new method for poultry disease prevention.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's evidence is based on a limited number of embryos and does not include long-term follow-up or broader host populations, which may affect the generalizability of the results. The evidence strength is moderate due to the controlled experimental setting and the lack of external validation.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the potential of using recombinant Lactococcus lactis expressing the H9N2 avian influenza virus hemagglutinin (HA) subunit 1 (HA1) protein as an in ovo vaccine to protect chicks against H9N2 infection. The study design involved 160 viable embryonated eggs randomly assigned to four groups, which were inoculated with either PBS, an inactivated H9N2 vaccine, an empty Lactococcus lactis vector, or recombinant Lactococcus lactis-HA1. The results showed that the recombinant Lactococcus lactis-HA1 significantly improved growth performance, immune indices, and intestinal development in chicks, while also reducing clinical symptoms and viral shedding following H9N2 challenge. The authors interpreted these findings as evidence that this approach may offer protective effects similar to those of the inactivated vaccine, potentially providing a new strategy for poultry disease prevention. However, the study's evidence is limited by its small sample size and controlled environment, resulting in moderate confidence in the findings.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在评估使用表达 H9N2 禽流感 病毒血凝素 (HA) 亚基 1 (HA1) 蛋白的重组乳酸乳球菌作为一种新型卵内 疫苗 蛋白来保护雏鸡免受 H9N2 感染的潜力。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究涉及 160 个存活的含胚卵,随机分配到四组,这些卵接种了 PBS、灭活的 H9N2 疫苗、空乳酸乳球菌 媒介 或表达 HA1 的重组乳酸乳球菌。通过in ovo 疫苗接种进行评价。
elements_zh.methods: 通过评估 H9N2 病毒攻击后雏鸡的临床表现、体重减轻、病毒脱落滴度和肺部病变,评估重组乳酸乳球菌-HA1 的功效。此外,还测量了血清HI滴度、HA特异性IgG、IL-2、IL-4、IFN-γ、粘膜SIgA浓度和淋巴细胞增殖反应等免疫相关指标。
elements_zh.main_results: 结果表明,卵内注射重组乳酸乳球菌-HA1可显着提高平均日增重(ADG)、饲料转化率(FCR)以及胸腺、脾脏、法氏囊等免疫指标,血清HI滴度,HA特异性IgG、IL-2、IL-4、IFN-γ以及粘膜SIgA浓度。它还增加了十二指肠和空肠中的 VH 和 VH/CD,并上调了肠屏障相关基因的转录。与 PBS 组和 L1 组相比,重组乳酸乳球菌-HA1 组的雏鸡临床症状较轻,体重减轻较少,病毒脱落滴度较低。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,在蛋内施用表达 HA1 的重组乳酸乳球菌可加速早期肠道成熟,并在肉鸡中诱导 HA1 特异性适应性 免疫应答,这可能提供与灭活的 疫苗 类似的保护作用。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,这种方法可能是开发针对 H9N2 疫苗 病毒的新型卵内 疫苗 的有前途的策略,有可能提高 疫苗 的功效,并为家禽疾病预防提供新方法。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的证据基于有限数量的胚胎,不包括长期随访或更广泛的 宿主 人群,这可能会影响结果的普遍性。由于受控实验设置和缺乏外部验证,证据强度中等。

papers.title: Publicly Available Genomic Evidence for Nipah and Avian Influenza Viruses in Bangladesh: A Scoping Assessment of Metadata Completeness and Surveillance Representativeness at the Human–Animal Interface
papers.abstract: Bangladesh experiences recurrent Nipah virus (NiV) outbreaks and sustained avian influenza virus (AIV) activity. Whether public genomic records contain metadata needed to assess surveillance representativeness across hosts, locations, and time is unclear.We conducted a structured, source-based scoping assessment of publicly documented NiV and AIV genomic records from Bangladesh (2001–2025), drawing on NCBI GenBank/INSDC and cited peer-reviewed and public-health sources. A pilot registry contained 108 entries (55 NiV, 53 AIV). Metadata were retained only when explicitly reported; unverified fields were recorded as not extracted. The registry is not a complete census. Five analytical questions were prespecified; several could not be evaluated because accession-level metadata were unavailable. The 33-accession AIV set containing H5N1 and H3N8 was excluded from H5/H9-specific interpretation. In the pilot registry, 9/108 entries (8.3%) had explicitly reported host species; the separate host-implied category was not added. Twelve entries (11.1%) had a full collection date; 21 (19.4%) had any collection date. Eight entries (7.4%) had an explicit district. The registry lists 22 NiV accession identifiers from a 2026 study, whereas the publication reports 23 newly sequenced N-gene records; this remains unresolved. Eight AIV accessions ( PV961349.1 – PV961356.1) represent eight segments of one chicken H5N1 isolate, not eight genomes. Twelve MN994-series records are HA-gene sequences from environmental live-bird-market samples.The pilot registry demonstrates substantial metadata limitations. Explicit host information was available for 8.3% of entries and explicit district for 7.4%; these prevent reliable quantitative assessment of host, district-level, and temporal representativeness and do not establish absence of surveillance or viral circulation. Accession-level reconstruction with transparent verification tiers and harmonised identifiers is required before quantitative representativeness indices or district-level priorities can be calculated.

papers.full_text: The arrival of highly pathogenic avian influenza A(H5N1) clade 2.3.4.4b on mainland Australia in June 2026 represents more than the loss of one of the last major geographic barriers to the current panzootic. It illustrates the capacity of this virus to exploit interconnected wildlife populations across continents and oceans. The first confirmed mainland detection occurred in a migratory brown skua ( Stercorarius antarcticus ) near Cape Le Grand National Park in Western Australia, followed by detection in a southern giant petrel. Genomic analyses indicate that these viruses were most closely related to those circulating on Heard Island in the southern Indian Ocean and suggest independent incursions from the sub‐Antarctic region rather than local transmission between the birds involved in the earliest detections [1, 2, 3].This finding marks another stage in the extraordinary intercontinental expansion of H5N1 clade 2.3.4.4b. Viruses belonging to this clade spread from Europe to North America, reached South America in 2022, and subsequently expanded into sub‐Antarctic islands and Antarctica. Genomic analyses of viruses collected in Antarctica have placed them within South American H5N1 diversity and revealed multiple independent introductions into the Antarctic region [4, 5]. By October 2025, H5N1 had reached Heard Island, approximately 4000 km southwest of mainland Australia, before viruses closely related to those circulating there were detected in migratory seabirds in Western Australia in 2026 [2, 3]. Rather than representing an isolated Australian event, this incursion therefore constitutes the latest extension of an interconnected transmission network spanning the Americas, Antarctic and sub‐Antarctic ecosystems, and Oceania.What followed illustrates the consequences of viral incursion into interconnected wildlife communities. By 23 October 2026, Australia had recorded 722 confirmed H5 avian influenza events in wildlife across multiple jurisdictions. Detections were no longer restricted to migratory seabirds but involved resident birds, raptors, and waterbirds, as well as multiple mammalian species, including long‐nosed fur seals, Australian sea lions, dolphins, red foxes, and southern elephant seals [6, 7]. Importantly, detections across several mammalian species do not themselves demonstrate sustained mammal‐to‐mammal transmission, and genomic investigation remains essential to distinguish repeated avian‐to‐mammalian spillover events from transmission within mammalian populations. Nevertheless, the rapid expansion across host species following the initial seabird incursions illustrates how quickly a wildlife incursion can evolve into a multispecies One Health challenge.Australia had implemented targeted surveillance before the mainland incursion, testing hundreds of wild birds and Australian sea lions without detecting H5N1 [8]. The subsequent emergence of the virus therefore highlights an important distinction: surveillance can provide early warning, but the absence of detection cannot eliminate the risk posed by highly mobile wildlife populations across vast and incompletely sampled ecosystems. The relevant question is no longer whether surveillance should be intensified, but whether existing surveillance and biosecurity paradigms are sufficiently adapted to a virus circulating across wildlife, environmental, and production interfaces.Experience from other affected countries illustrates the limitations of relying on conventional farm‐level biosecurity alone. During the 2022–2023 H5N1 epidemic in Japan, commercial layer farms housing ≥ 100,000 birds were at increased risk of HPAI introduction, whereas basic biosecurity measures, including changing footwear at poultry‐house entrances, were associated with reduced risk [9]. These findings illustrate how farm structure and flock size can influence vulnerability to viral introduction and reinforce that biosecurity cannot be considered independently of production characteristics, human movement, and environmental exposure.Europe provides an equally important warning. During June–August 2026, HPAI A(H5N1) continued to circulate in wild birds across Europe, with 103 detections reported in 11 countries. Although only two poultry outbreaks were reported during this period, direct or indirect contact with wild birds remained the main source of HPAI virus introduction into domestic bird establishments [10]. This persistent wildlife‐to‐poultry interface highlights how repeated viral incursions can remain a major vulnerability even in regions with established surveillance and animal‐health infrastructure.These observations raise a broader question for global H5N1 governance. Current international frameworks appropriately emphasize outbreak notification, poultry biosecurity, surveillance, rapid response, and scientifically justified trade measures [1]. However, the contemporary ecology of H5N1 clade 2.3.4.4b extends far beyond a predominantly poultry‐centered model of disease control. Persistent circulation in wild birds, environmental contamination, long‐distance viral dispersal through migratory species, and recurrent spillover into terrestrial and marine mammals increasingly challenge approaches centered primarily on farms and recognized outbreaks. The continued global expansion of H5N1 therefore calls for international guidance to evolve beyond reactive outbreak management towards sustained management of interconnected wildlife‐environment‐livestock interfaces.Australia has an opportunity to incorporate these lessons before widespread poultry involvement occurs. As of 24 October 2026, no H5N1 clade 2.3.4.4b infections had been detected in Australian poultry or humans, and the risk to the general population remained low [6, 11]. Preserving this separation will require more than replicating control systems developed elsewhere. Wildlife and environmental surveillance should be directly linked to risk‐based interventions in poultry, whereas genomic sequencing should be sufficiently rapid and representative to reconstruct introduction and transmission pathways. Farm biosecurity should account for production structure and environmental exposure rather than rely solely on standardized measures, and surveillance of occupationally exposed people should be integrated with animal‐health signals. For threatened wildlife, mortality surveillance should also be linked to population‐level ecological monitoring so that conservation impacts can be recognized before population declines become irreversible.Australia's H5N1 outbreak is therefore not simply a new national biosecurity emergency. It is the latest chapter in a panzootic that has progressively crossed geographic, ecological, and host barriers. Its expansion from the Americas through Antarctic and sub‐Antarctic ecosystems to Oceania illustrates why no country can regard H5N1 circulation in wildlife beyond its borders as an external problem. Experiences in Japan and Europe further show that established surveillance and farm biosecurity systems cannot eliminate the risk of repeated viral incursions. The challenge for Australia, and for international animal‐health governance, is therefore to move beyond preparedness frameworks focused primarily on detecting and containing outbreaks towards systems capable of anticipating viral movement across wildlife, environmental, agricultural, and human interfaces. Ultimately, the success of Australia's response should be measured not only by how rapidly H5N1 is detected but also by whether the lessons from this panzootic can prevent the next interface from being crossed. analysis.research_question_and_background: This study addresses the need to understand the spread of H5N1 avian influenza and its implications for global health, highlighting the virus's ability to expand beyond traditional geographic barriers.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study describes the detection of H5N1 clade 2.3.4.4b in migratory birds across Australia, including a brown skua and a southern giant petrel, and traces its origin to Heard Island in the southern Indian Ocean.
analysis.methods: Genomic analyses were conducted to determine the relationship between the detected viruses and those circulating in Heard Island, suggesting independent incursions rather than local transmission.
analysis.main_results: The first confirmed mainland detection of H5N1 clade 2.3.4.4b in Australia was in a brown skua and a southern giant petrel, with genomic evidence indicating these viruses were most closely related to those on Heard Island.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings demonstrate the virus's capacity to spread across continents and oceans through interconnected wildlife populations, marking a new stage in its intercontinental expansion.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The study provides critical insights into the surveillance and preparedness needed for H5N1 avian influenza, emphasizing the importance of monitoring migratory bird populations for early detection.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its reliance on genomic data from a small number of detected cases, but the evidence is strong due to the clear genetic relationship to viruses on Heard Island.

analysis.summary_en: This study examines the spread of H5N1 avian influenza in Australia, highlighting the virus's ability to expand beyond traditional geographic barriers. The first confirmed mainland detection occurred in a brown skua and a southern giant petrel near Cape Le Grand National Park, with genomic analyses indicating these viruses were most closely related to those on Heard Island in the southern Indian Ocean. The findings suggest independent incursions from the sub-Antarctic region rather than local transmission, marking another stage in the intercontinental expansion of H5N1 clade 2.3.4.4b. The study underscores the need for enhanced surveillance of migratory bird populations to monitor and prepare for future outbreaks. While the study is limited by its reliance on a small number of cases, the genetic evidence supports the conclusion that the virus has outgrown conventional preparedness measures. These insights have significant implications for global health and wildlife disease monitoring.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 这项研究满足了了解 H5N1 禽流感 的传播及其对全球健康的影响的需要,强调了该病毒超越传统地理障碍的能力。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究描述了在澳大利亚各地的候鸟(包括棕色贼鸥和南方巨海燕)中检测到的 H5N1 进化枝 2.3.4.4b,并将其起源追溯到南印度洋的赫德岛。
elements_zh.methods: 进行基因组分析以确定检测到的病毒与赫德岛传播的病毒之间的关系,表明独立入侵而不是本地 传播。
elements_zh.main_results: 澳大利亚首次在大陆检测到 H5N1 进化枝 2.3.4.4b 是在棕色贼鸥和南方巨海燕身上,基因组证据表明这些病毒与赫德岛上的病毒关系最密切。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,该病毒有能力通过相互关联的野生动物种群跨大陆和海洋传播,标志着其洲际扩张进入了一个新阶段。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该研究提供了对 监测 和 H5N1 禽流感 所需的准备工作的重要见解,强调了监测候鸟种群以进行早期发现的重要性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究由于依赖于少数已发现病例的基因组数据而受到限制,但由于与赫德岛病毒有明确的遗传关系,因此证据确凿。

papers.title: Lipid nanoparticle-encapsulated DNA vaccine induces robust and durable immunity against avian influenza viruses in chickens
papers.abstract: To evaluate the immunogenicity of lipid nanoparticle (LNP)-encapsulated DNA vaccines against avian influenza virus in chickens, hemagglutinin (HA) genes from three surrogate low pathogenic avian influenza virus (LPAIV) subtypes, H2N2, H5N3, and H6N8, were cloned into an expression plasmid and formulated as monovalent or bivalent LNP-pDNA vaccines. A single intramuscular dose of 5 or 15 μg of monovalent LNP-pDNA vaccines induced strong hemagglutination inhibition (HI) antibody responses in chickens, with titers exceeding 1:64 and 1:128 respectively, whereas equivalent doses of naked DNA failed to elicit detectable HI antibodies. The bivalent LNP-pDNA vaccine containing H2 and H6 HA genes elicited HI antibody responses against both subtypes. Furthermore, a single immunization with the LNP-pDNA vaccine encoding the H5 antigen induced durable antibody responses, with HI titers above 1:32 maintained for nearly six months. At the 15-μg dose, the LNP-pDNA vaccine significantly reduced viral shedding in respiratory secretions and prevented detectable viral infection in the lungs following challenge with the homologous LPAIV H5N3 virus. Overall, LNP encapsulation markedly enhances the immunogenicity of pDNA vaccines in poultry. Thus, this study provides a proof-of-evidence that LNP-pDNA can be a safe and effective strategy for controlling avian influenza viruses in poultry.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在评估脂质纳米颗粒 (LNP) 封装的 DNA 疫苗 对鸡中 禽流感 病毒的免疫原性,重点关注低致病性 禽流感 病毒 (LPAIV) 亚型。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究涉及给鸡单次肌肉注射 5 或 15 μg 单价 LNP-pDNA 疫苗,并与裸露 DNA 疫苗 进行比较。测试了二价 疫苗 诱导针对两种亚型 H2 和 H6 的免疫力的能力。
elements_zh.methods: 疫苗 使用 LPAIV 亚型的 HA 基因配制,并测试其诱导血凝抑制 (HI) 抗体反应的能力。进行了同源 H5N3 病毒的攻击研究以评估 疫苗 的功效。
elements_zh.main_results: 在 15 μg 剂量下,LNP-pDNA 疫苗 显着减少了呼吸道分泌物中的病毒脱落,并防止了同源 LPAIV H5N3 病毒攻击后肺部可检测到的病毒感染。二价 疫苗 诱导针对 H2 和 H6 亚型的 HI 抗体应答。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 结果表明,LNP-pDNA 疫苗 可以在鸡中诱导针对 禽流感 病毒的强大而持久的免疫力,为 疫苗 在家禽中的开发提供了一种新方法。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,LNP-pDNA 疫苗 可能是控制家禽 禽流感 的宝贵工具,有可能降低人畜共患 传播 的风险并增强疾病预防策略。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于单剂量和一组特定的 LPAIV 亚型,但由于与裸露 DNA 的直接比较和挑战模型的使用,证据很充分。

papers.title: Protective Efficacy of Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza Vaccines Against Mortality in Chickens: A Meta-Analysis and Systematic Review of Experimental Challenge Trials
papers.abstract: Highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) remains a major threat to poultry production and animal welfare. This systematic review and meta-analysis evaluated the association between HPAI vaccination and mortality in experimentally challenged chickens and explored biological and operational sources of heterogeneity. Experimental studies comparing mortality in vaccinated and unvaccinated chickens following HPAI challenge were eligible. A Scopus search up to 30 of August 2025, supplemented by reference screening identified 66 eligible articles comprising 158 studies. Mortality relative risks (RRs) were analysed using random-effects models, with moderator analyses and exploratory multivariable sensitivity analyses. Risk of bias was assessed using the SYRCLE tool. Vaccination markedly reduced mortality (pooled RR = 0.11, 95% CI: 0.08–0.14), although heterogeneity was substantial (I2 = 88.4%). A trim-and-fill sensitivity analysis yielded a less pronounced protective association (RR = 0.335, 95% CI: 0.293–0.383). Univariate analyses suggested differences between vaccine platforms and administration routes, but exploratory adjusted comparisons were sensitive to model specification and incomplete characterisation of host immunity, antigen dose, adjuvant formulation, viral clade and challenge conditions. Inconsistent reporting of vaccine–challenge genetic and antigenic relationships prevented their reliable inclusion as moderators, while substantial unexplained heterogeneity remained. Risk-of-bias assessments revealed substantial methodological uncertainty, while inconsistent reporting of antigenic relationships prevented their reliable evaluation as moderators. papers.title: Mortality in Wild Otters Linked to HPAI (H5N1) in Chile, 2023
papers.abstract: This study documents molecular detection of highly pathogenic avian influenza A(H5N1) clade 2.3.4.4b in wild marine otters (Lontra felina) and a Southern river otter (Lontra provocax) in Chile in 2023. Analysis of official SERNAPESCA stranding records identified an increase in reported otter mortality in 2023 relative to previous years, coinciding geographically and temporally with the regional H5N1 outbreak in wild birds and mammals. Five individual otters yielded H5N1-positive RT-qPCR results across six specimens. Phylogenetic analyses of recovered viral sequences were consistent with the genetic diversity of viruses circulating in Chile and Peru during the South American outbreak. These molecular findings and epidemiological observations support an association between H5N1 circulation and reported otter mortality, but do not establish the cause of death of individual animals or the proportion of deaths attributable to infection. Integrated wildlife surveillance is warranted to better understand the potential impact of H5N1 on these vulnerable species.

papers.title: pH-based inactivation of highly pathogenic H5N1 virus in unpasteurized milk
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT An outbreak of highly pathogenic avian influenza H5N1 was confirmed in dairy cattle in March 2024 and subsequently spread to dairy herds throughout the United States, resulting in spillover cases in humans and other animals. Milk produced by infected dairy cattle, which has been shown to harbor high viral titers, poses a potential threat to peridomestic wildlife around dairies due to lack of treatment and disposal in wastewater systems that are often open to the environment. Here, we investigated a method for inactivating H5N1 virus in unpasteurized milk, utilizing the irreversible conformational change of the hemagglutinin (HA) glycoprotein induced by low pH. The pH needed for complete inactivation of three distinct influenza A viruses was determined for subsequent use in acidifying milk. The use of common, readily available acidification solutions like vinegar demonstrated that a 3% final concentration of vinegar (pH 3.6) induced complete inactivation of H5N1 in unpasteurized milk after 60 min. Our results suggest that pH-based inactivation of H5N1 in unpasteurized milk is a quick, feasible strategy that could be used on dairy farms prior to disposal of contaminated milk, thus reducing the risks of environmental contamination and exposure of animals around farms. IMPORTANCE Dairy farms experiencing outbreaks of highly pathogenic avian influenza H5N1 generate large volumes of milk with high titers of infectious H5N1 virus. While milk from sick cows does not enter the consumer supply chain, disposal of this untreated, contaminated milk through on-site wastewater systems still poses a significant risk for environmental contamination and exposure of peridomestic wildlife, potentially leading to spillover events. A simple method for inactivation of virus in milk prior to disposal could mitigate this risk. We show that lowering the pH of virus-laden milk with commercially available vinegar can neutralize dairy cattle H5N1 virus within 1 h, providing a quick and effective strategy for potential use on dairies to inactivate the virus in milk before disposal.

papers.title_zh: 基于 pH 值灭活未经巴氏消毒的牛奶中的高致病性 H5N1 病毒
papers.source_body_en: ABSTRACT An outbreak of highly pathogenic avian influenza H5N1 was confirmed in dairy cattle in March 2024 and subsequently spread to dairy herds throughout the United States, resulting in spillover cases in humans and other animals. Milk produced by infected dairy cattle, which has been shown to harbor high viral titers, poses a potential threat to peridomestic wildlife around dairies due to lack of treatment and disposal in wastewater systems that are often open to the environment. Here, we investigated a method for inactivating H5N1 virus in unpasteurized milk, utilizing the irreversible conformational change of the hemagglutinin (HA) glycoprotein induced by low pH. The pH needed for complete inactivation of three distinct influenza A viruses was determined for subsequent use in acidifying milk. The use of common, readily available acidification solutions like vinegar demonstrated that a 3% final concentration of vinegar (pH 3.6) induced complete inactivation of H5N1 in unpasteurized milk after 60 min. Our results suggest that pH-based inactivation of H5N1 in unpasteurized milk is a quick, feasible strategy that could be used on dairy farms prior to disposal of contaminated milk, thus reducing the risks of environmental contamination and exposure of animals around farms. IMPORTANCE Dairy farms experiencing outbreaks of highly pathogenic avian influenza H5N1 generate large volumes of milk with high titers of infectious H5N1 virus. While milk from sick cows does not enter the consumer supply chain, disposal of this untreated, contaminated milk through on-site wastewater systems still poses a significant risk for environmental contamination and exposure of peridomestic wildlife, potentially leading to spillover events. A simple method for inactivation of virus in milk prior to disposal could mitigate this risk. We show that lowering the pH of virus-laden milk with commercially available vinegar can neutralize dairy cattle H5N1 virus within 1 h, providing a quick and effective strategy for potential use on dairies to inactivate the virus in milk before disposal.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 2024 年 3 月,高致病性禽流感 H5N1 的 暴发 在奶牛中得到证实,随后传播到美国各地的奶牛群,导致人类和其他动物出现 跨物种溢出 病例。受感染的奶牛生产的牛奶已被证明具有高病毒滴度,由于缺乏 治疗 以及在通常向环境开放的废水系统中的处理,对奶牛场周围的野生动物构成潜在威胁。在这里,我们研究了一种在未经巴氏消毒的牛奶中灭活 H5N1 病毒的方法,该方法利用低 pH 诱导的血凝素 (HA) 糖蛋白的不可逆构象变化。确定了三种不同甲型流感病毒完全灭活所需的 pH 值,以便随后用于酸化牛奶。使用常见的、现成的酸化溶液(如醋)表明,最终浓度为 3% 的醋(pH 3.6)在 60 分钟后可诱导未经巴氏消毒的牛奶中的 H5N1 完全失活。我们的研究结果表明,在未经巴氏消毒的牛奶中基于 pH 值灭活 H5N1 是一种快速、可行的策略,可在奶牛场处置受污染的牛奶之前使用,从而降低环境污染和农场周围动物接触的风险。重要性 经历 高致病性禽流感 H5N1 病毒的奶牛场会产生大量含有高滴度传染性 H5N1 病毒的牛奶。虽然来自病牛的牛奶不会进入消费者供应链,但通过现场废水系统处理这种未经处理的受污染牛奶仍然对环境污染和家中野生动物暴露造成重大风险,可能导致 跨物种溢出 事件。在处理牛奶之前采用一种简单的方法灭活牛奶中的病毒可以减轻这种风险。我们证明,用市售醋降低载有病毒的牛奶的 pH 值可以在 1 小时内中和奶牛 H5N1 病毒,为乳品厂在处理前灭活牛奶中的病毒提供了一种快速有效的策略。

papers.title: Viral Pathogens as Global Health Threats: Review of Transmissibility, Lethality, and Pandemic Potential
papers.abstract: Viral pathogens vary substantially in their transmissibility, lethality, and potential to cause widespread epidemics or pandemics. Measles, for example, is exceptionally contagious but has relatively low case fatality in populations with access to modern medical care. Conversely, rabies, Nipah virus, Ebola virus, and Marburg virus can cause severe disease with high case fatality rates but generally exhibit limited sustained human-to-human transmission. The greatest global threats, therefore, are not necessarily the most contagious or lethal viruses, but those that combine efficient transmission, substantial clinical severity, zoonotic reservoirs, evolutionary adaptability, and limited preventive or therapeutic options. The COVID-19 pandemic illustrated this convergence of risk factors, demonstrating how efficient transmission, including presymptomatic and asymptomatic spread, coupled with clinically significant disease can produce devastating global consequences. Influenza A viruses remain a major pandemic concern because of their extensive animal reservoirs, capacity for antigenic evolution, and established history of human pandemics. Highly pathogenic avian influenza A(H5N1) is particularly concerning given the high case fatality observed among confirmed human cases, although sustained human-to-human transmission has not been established. In contrast, henipaviruses and filoviruses pose substantial clinical threats because of their high lethality, despite comparatively limited transmissibility. This review critically examines major viral threats through three interconnected determinants of global health risk: transmissibility, infection fatality risk, and the biological and epidemiological factors governing their epidemic and pandemic potential.

Measles, for example, is exceptionally contagious but has relatively low case fatality in populations with access to modern medical care. Conversely, rabies, Nipah virus, Ebola virus, and Marburg virus can cause severe disease with high case fatality rates but generally exhibit limited sustained human-to-human transmission. In contrast, henipaviruses and filoviruses pose substantial clinical threats because of their high lethality, despite comparatively limited transmissibility. This review critically examines major viral threats through three interconnected determinants of global health risk: transmissibility, infection fatality risk, and the biological and epidemiological factors governing their epidemic and pandemic potential.

papers.title: Proximity Proteomics Reveals Interactome Rewiring Driven by the Mammalian-Adaptive PB2-E627K Mutation of Avian Influenza Polymerase
papers.abstract: Abstract The polymerase basic protein 2 (PB2) E627K substitution in the influenza A virus polymerase is a key determinant of mammalian adaptation, yet its impact on the host interaction remains incompletely understood. Using TurboID proximity labeling in human cells, we profiled host proteins associated with wild-type and E627K mutant H5N1 polymerase in both isolated PB2 and trimeric (PA-PB1-PB2) contexts, identifying 204 high-confidence proximal interactions. Polymerase assembly drives the PB2-associated interactome, with substantially expanded host interactions detected in the trimeric context compared to PB2 alone. E627K remodels host associations, shifting interactions related to cellular structural organization and intracellular trafficking while preserving nuclear transport and RNP assembly. WT-associated but E627K-lost proteins relate to host RNA processing and protein quality control pathways. Differential interaction scoring distinguished polymerase assembly dependent interactions from PB2-alone associations. Integration of coimmunoprecipitation and AlphaFold3 provided complementary evidence for representative interactions and revealed host factors engage polymerase through subunits other than PB2, highlighting the importance of the assembled complex for interaction recognition. Together, these findings demonstrate that PB2-E627K selectively redistributes interaction preferences within a conserved functional landscape. This study provides a resource for understanding influenza virus adaptation and identifies candidate host factors for further investigation.

papers.title_zh: 邻近蛋白质组学揭示了由 禽流感 聚合酶的哺乳动物适应性 PB2-E627K 突变 驱动的相互作用组重新布线
papers.source_body_en: Abstract The polymerase basic protein 2 (PB2) E627K substitution in the influenza A virus polymerase is a key determinant of mammalian adaptation, yet its impact on the host interaction remains incompletely understood. Using TurboID proximity labeling in human cells, we profiled host proteins associated with wild-type and E627K mutant H5N1 polymerase in both isolated PB2 and trimeric (PA-PB1-PB2) contexts, identifying 204 high-confidence proximal interactions. Polymerase assembly drives the PB2-associated interactome, with substantially expanded host interactions detected in the trimeric context compared to PB2 alone. E627K remodels host associations, shifting interactions related to cellular structural organization and intracellular trafficking while preserving nuclear transport and RNP assembly. WT-associated but E627K-lost proteins relate to host RNA processing and protein quality control pathways. Differential interaction scoring distinguished polymerase assembly dependent interactions from PB2-alone associations. Integration of coimmunoprecipitation and AlphaFold3 provided complementary evidence for representative interactions and revealed host factors engage polymerase through subunits other than PB2, highlighting the importance of the assembled complex for interaction recognition. Together, these findings demonstrate that PB2-E627K selectively redistributes interaction preferences within a conserved functional landscape. This study provides a resource for understanding influenza virus adaptation and identifies candidate host factors for further investigation.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要:甲型流感病毒聚合酶中的聚合酶碱性蛋白 2 (PB2) E627K 取代是哺乳动物适应的关键决定因素,但其对 宿主 相互作用的影响仍不完全清楚。在人类细胞中使用 TurboID 邻近标记,我们在分离的 PB2 和三聚体 (PA-PB1-PB2) 环境中分析了与野生型和 E627K 突变 H5N1 聚合酶相关的 宿主 蛋白,识别了 204 个高可信度的邻近相互作用。聚合酶组装驱动 PB2 相关的相互作用组,与单独的 PB2 相比,在三聚体环境中检测到的 宿主 相互作用显着扩展。E627K 重塑 宿主 关联,改变与细胞结构组织和细胞内运输相关的相互作用,同时保留核运输和 RNP 组装。WT 相关但 E627K 丢失的蛋白质与 宿主 RNA 加工和蛋白质质量控​​制途径相关。差异相互作用评分将聚合酶组装依赖性相互作用与单独的 PB2 关联区分开来。免疫共沉淀和 AlphaFold3 的整合为代表性相互作用提供了补充证据,并揭示了 宿主 因子通过 PB2 以外的亚基与聚合酶结合,强调了组装复合物对于相互作用识别的重要性。总之,这些发现表明 PB2-E627K 在保守的功能景观中选择性地重新分配相互作用偏好。这项研究为了解流感病毒适应提供了资源,并确定了候选 宿主 因素以供进一步研究。

papers.title: Semantic repeatability and reproducibility of GPT-5 and Gemini 3 Flash on H5N1 One Health questions
papers.abstract: Highly pathogenic avian influenza A(H5N1) has re-emerged as a One Health concern since 2024, and the public is increasingly consulting large-language-model (LLM) chatbots for health information during outbreaks. Before a chatbot's accuracy can be meaningfully assessed, its consistency must first be understood, so that any single response can be trusted as a fair representative of the model's behavior. We characterized the semantic repeatability and reproducibility of GPT-5 (OpenAI) and Gemini 3 Flash (Google) on 15 H5N1 One Health questions sourced from social media discourse by adopting and extending a centroid-based evaluation framework. Each question was submitted 30 times and reformulated using five Chain-of-Thought (CoT) variants with 30 runs each, yielding 5,400 responses. Pairwise cosine similarity was computed on MPNet embeddings, with sensitivity analyses across three additional transformers. Statistical inference combined standard nonparametric tests (paired Wilcoxon and Friedman with Holm--Bonferroni correction) with inter-embedding agreement statistics (ICC(2,k) and Cronbach's $\alpha$) introduced here as a methodological addition. Both models produced high mean consistency (0.93--0.97, rescaled to {[}0, 1{]}). GPT-5 showed reproducibility significantly higher than repeatability (W = 3.0, p = 0.0003), whereas for Gemini 3 Flash the two metrics were statistically indistinguishable (W = 42.0, p = 0.33). Differential Diagnosis ranked among the top two CoT framings for consistency in both models. The tested chatbots behave as semantically stable sources on H5N1 One Health questions, and the developed consistency evaluation framework is portable to other domains.

papers.title: Development of a sensitive and rapid on-site detection method for avian influenza virus in wildlife using reverse transcription loop-mediated isothermal amplification.
papers.abstract: The global spread of H5 high pathogenicity avian influenza virus (HPAIV) severely threatens wildlife, posing a critical challenge for conservation medicine. Although immunochromatographic (IC) kits are commonly used for on-site diagnosis of wildlife samples, their low sensitivity often results in false negatives. Highly sensitive molecular methods, such as reverse transcription quantitative polymerase chain reaction (RT-qPCR), are often impractical for field use because of the need for sophisticated equipment. Therefore, a sensitive and affordable on-site diagnostic tool is essential for early detection of HPAIV in wildlife samples collected in the field. In this study, a reverse transcription loop-mediated isothermal amplification (RT-LAMP) assay targeting M gene for the on-site detection of avian influenza virus (AIV) was developed and evaluated. Initially, the assay using liquid reagents was validated in terms of specificity and sensitivity to confirm the appropriateness of the reaction mixture composition. This assay exhibited high specificity and exclusively detected AIVs without cross-reactivity. Sensitivity analysis using swabs from HPAIV-infected ducks demonstrated that the assay was comparable to RT-qPCR but substantially superior to IC kits. The reaction reagents were lyophilized to minimize the testing procedure for practical field use. This simplified protocol using lyophilized reagents and a portable incubator yielded results that were highly concordant with those of RT-qPCR. These findings indicate that the RT-LAMP assay serves as a robust diagnostic resource, supporting wildlife conservation strategies by enabling rapid, sensitive, and early detection of AIV infection in the field.
papers.journal: The Journal of veterinary medical science

papers.title: Structural and functional characterization of hemagglutinin E190D and Q226H minor variants in human H5N1 A/British Columbia/PHL-2032/2024
papers.abstract: In late 2024, an avian H5N1 influenza virus derived from clade 2.3.4.4b was isolated from a severe human infection in British Columbia (A/British Columbia/PHL-2032/2024), revealing a rare combination of substitutions E190D and Q226H as minor variants in the receptor-binding site (RBS). We recombinantly produced hemagglutinins (HA) harboring these mutations and conducted receptor-binding and structural analyses. The wild-type HA with hallmark residues E190 and Q226 retained strong binding to α2-3 N-linked glycans, whereas E190D and Q226H abolished binding to α2-3 N- and O-linked glycans and no switch to α2-6 sialosides. The bulkier H226 caused steric clashes within the RBS, whereas E190D eliminated a conserved hydrogen bond with Sia-1, disrupting receptor engagement. Although D190 and H226 in this isolate are deleterious to engagement with known glycan receptors and not compatible with human-to-human transmission, continued surveillance is essential to monitor any changes in key RBS residues in circulating H5N1 viruses.

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to investigate the impact of minor variants E190D and Q226H in the receptor-binding site (RBS) of an avian H5N1 influenza virus isolated from a severe human infection in British Columbia, as these substitutions were identified as rare and potentially significant for viral function.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study involved recombinant production of hemagglutinins (HA) with the E190D and Q226H mutations and conducted receptor-binding and structural analyses on these variants, comparing them to the wild-type HA with hallmark residues E190 and Q226.
analysis.methods: The researchers produced recombinant hemagglutinins (HA) with the E190D and Q226H mutations and performed receptor-binding assays and structural analyses to evaluate their interactions with glycan receptors.
analysis.main_results: The wild-type HA retained strong binding to α2-3 N-linked glycans, while the E190D and Q226H variants abolished binding to both α2-3 N- and O-linked glycans and did not switch to α2-6 sialosides. The Q226H mutation caused steric clashes within the RBS, and the E190D mutation eliminated a conserved hydrogen bond with Sia-1, disrupting receptor engagement.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings demonstrate that the E190D and Q226H substitutions in the RBS of this H5N1 isolate are detrimental to receptor binding, which may hinder its ability to engage with human receptors, though continued surveillance is necessary to monitor potential changes in circulating viruses.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results highlight the importance of monitoring key receptor-binding site (RBS) residues in H5N1 viruses to assess their potential for adaptation and transmission to humans, informing surveillance and public health strategies.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to structural and functional analyses of recombinant hemagglutinins, and the evidence is based on in vitro experiments, which may not fully represent in vivo behavior. The evidence strength is moderate.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the impact of minor variants E190D and Q226H in the receptor-binding site (RBS) of an avian H5N1 influenza virus isolated from a severe human infection in British Columbia. The researchers produced recombinant hemagglutinins (HA) with these mutations and conducted receptor-binding and structural analyses. The wild-type HA retained strong binding to α2-3 N-linked glycans, whereas the E190D and Q226H variants abolished binding to both α2-3 N- and O-linked glycans and did not switch to α2-6 sialosides. The Q226H mutation caused steric clashes within the RBS, and the E190D mutation disrupted a conserved hydrogen bond with Sia-1, impairing receptor engagement. The authors suggest that these substitutions may hinder the virus's ability to engage with human receptors, though continued surveillance is essential to monitor potential changes in circulating H5N1 viruses. The study's findings have implications for understanding the functional impact of these variants and their relevance to public health, but the evidence is based on in vitro experiments, limiting its generalizability. The evidence strength is moderate.

elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于重组血凝素的结构和功能分析,证据基于体外实验,可能无法完全代表体内行为。证据强度中等。

papers.title: Integrating Epidemiology and Host Immunogenomics Against Transboundary Animal Viral Threats
papers.abstract: Transboundary animal viruses cross national borders and, increasingly, species barriers. Since 2019, lumpy skin disease virus has spread across Asia and into Western Europe, peste des petits ruminants virus has entered the European Union, foot-and-mouth disease has reemerged in Central Europe, and H5N1 avian influenza has become established in dairy cattle. These threats are usually studied from two separate perspectives. Field and genomic epidemiology describe where viruses circulate, how they spread, and what they cost, whereas host immunogenomics investigates why some animals resist infection or respond better to vaccination. Integrating these perspectives can provide a more complete understanding of host–pathogen interactions and inform more effective disease prevention and control. This review examines six representative viruses: peste des petits ruminants virus (PPRV), foot-and-mouth disease virus (FMDV), African swine fever virus (ASFV), lumpy skin disease virus (LSDV), porcine reproductive and respiratory syndrome virus (PRRSV), and H5N1 avian influenza virus, and the threats they pose to animal health and production. We summarize the epidemiological and immunogenomic approaches available to investigate these threats and propose an integrated framework linking both fields to four control outcomes: targeted surveillance, improved vaccine matching, selective breeding for disease resistance, and evidence-informed policymaking. We also assess the feasibility of this framework in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs) and smallholder farming systems, where disease burdens are high but the evidence base remains limited, and we highlight that host genomic research is concentrated in pigs despite the heavy disease burden in small ruminants. By connecting population-level patterns of viral transmission with host-level variation in susceptibility and immune response, this review identifies opportunities to strengthen the surveillance and control of transboundary animal viral diseases.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review focuses on avian influenza A viruses, examining their role in transboundary animal viral threats, particularly their impact on animal health and production. It explores how these viruses cross national and species borders and investigates the integration of epidemiology and host immunogenomics to better understand host–pathogen interactions and improve disease prevention and control.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a systematic analysis of six representative viruses, including avian influenza A viruses. It outlines the epidemiological and immunogenomic approaches used to study these viruses and proposes an integrated framework for disease control. The review does not explicitly report on meta-analysis or pooled estimates but emphasizes the synthesis of available evidence.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review highlights that avian influenza A viruses pose significant transboundary threats, particularly in regions where they have become established in dairy cattle and other livestock. It concludes that integrating epidemiological and immunogenomic data can enhance understanding of host–pathogen dynamics and lead to more effective disease control strategies.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review notes that host genomic research is disproportionately focused on pigs, despite the high disease burden in small ruminants. It also identifies gaps in the evidence base for low- and middle-income countries (LMICs) and smallholder farming systems, where disease control is most challenging.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review proposes specific research and practice priorities, including targeted surveillance, improved vaccine matching, selective breeding for disease resistance, and evidence-informed policymaking. It emphasizes the need for more genomic research on small ruminants and better integration of data across different host species and regions.

analysis.summary_en: This review explores the transboundary threats posed by avian influenza A viruses, emphasizing their spread across species and regions. It highlights the need to integrate epidemiological and immunogenomic approaches to better understand host–pathogen interactions and improve disease prevention and control. It proposes actionable strategies such as targeted surveillance, improved vaccine development, and evidence-based policies to address these threats. The integration of these perspectives is seen as critical for strengthening disease control efforts.
